tools.name: list_projects
tools.description: List all Honeybadger projects (returns summary info; use get_project for full details)

account_id.description: Optional account ID to filter projects by specific account

tools.name: get_project
tools.description: Get a single Honeybadger project by ID

id.description: The ID of the project to retrieve

tools.name: list_faults
tools.description: Get a list of faults for a project with optional filtering and ordering. Requires reference topic: errors (fetch via get_reference; skip if still visible in your context) for the fault/notice model and the q search syntax.

created_after.description: Filter faults created after this timestamp

limit.description: Maximum number of faults to return (max 25)

occurred_after.description: Filter faults that occurred after this timestamp

occurred_before.description: Filter faults that occurred before this timestamp

project_id.description: The ID of the project to get faults for

q.description: Search string to filter faults (see the errors reference topic for the search query syntax)

tools.name: get_fault
tools.description: Get detailed information for a specific fault in a project

fault_id.description: The ID of the fault to retrieve

project_id.description: The ID of the project containing the fault

tools.name: list_fault_notices
tools.description: Get a list of notices (individual error events) for a specific fault

created_after.description: Filter notices created after this timestamp

created_before.description: Filter notices created before this timestamp

fault_id.description: The ID of the fault to get notices for

limit.description: Maximum number of notices to return (max 25)

project_id.description: The ID of the project containing the fault

tools.name: list_fault_comments
tools.description: List comments on a fault. Returns the first page of comments; pagination is not currently supported.

fault_id.description: The ID of the fault containing the comments

project_id.description: The ID of the project containing the fault

tools.name: list_fault_affected_users
tools.description: Get a list of users who were affected by a specific fault with occurrence counts

fault_id.description: The ID of the fault to get affected users for

project_id.description: The ID of the project containing the fault

q.description: Search string to filter affected users

tools.name: get_fault_counts
tools.description: Get fault count statistics for a project with optional filtering. Requires reference topic: errors (fetch via get_reference; skip if still visible in your context) for the q search syntax.

created_after.description: Filter faults created after this timestamp

occurred_after.description: Filter faults that occurred after this timestamp

occurred_before.description: Filter faults that occurred before this timestamp

project_id.description: The ID of the project to get fault counts for

q.description: Search string to filter faults (see the errors reference topic for the search query syntax)

tools.name: update_fault
tools.description: Update a fault's resolved, ignored, assignee, or resolve-on-deploy state. Only the provided fields are changed. Setting resolved or ignored to true in the same request takes precedence over resolve_on_deploy.

assignee_id.description: Positive integer to assign that user; null to remove the current assignee; omit to leave unchanged

fault_id.description: The ID of the fault to update

project_id.description: The ID of the project containing the fault

resolve_on_deploy.description: Mark the fault to be resolved automatically on next deploy

tools.name: create_fault_comment
tools.description: Add a comment to a fault.

body.description: The comment text (must not be blank)

fault_id.description: The ID of the fault containing the comments

project_id.description: The ID of the project containing the fault

tools.name: get_reference
tools.description: Returns Honeybadger reference documentation by topic. Topics: badgerql (query language), queries (Insights query fundamentals: streams, time ranges, field grounding), charts (visualization views, chart_config), dashboards (widgets, layout), alarms (trigger_config, states, patterns), errors (fault/notice model, error search syntax), checkins (cron/scheduled-task monitoring: schedule types, plan gating, timezone format, report payloads, lifecycle states). Fetch all topics you need in one call, e.g. topics: ["badgerql", "charts"]; skip topics still visible in your context. Call with no arguments for a topic index, or ["all"] for everything.

topics.description: Reference topics to fetch: badgerql, queries, charts, dashboards, alarms, errors, checkins, or all. Omit for an index of topics.

tools.name: list_check_ins
tools.description: List check-ins (cron/scheduled task monitoring) for a Honeybadger project. Returns the first 25 check-ins; pagination is not currently supported. To interpret check-in state and schedule fields, fetch reference topic: checkins (via get_reference).

project_id.description: The ID of the project to list check-ins for

tools.name: get_check_in
tools.description: Get a single check-in by ID. To interpret check-in state and schedule fields, fetch reference topic: checkins (via get_reference).

check_in_id.description: The ID of the check-in to retrieve

project_id.description: The ID of the project the check-in belongs to

tools.name: create_check_in
tools.description: Create a new check-in for a Honeybadger project. Check-ins monitor cron jobs and scheduled tasks by alerting when an expected report doesn't arrive. IMPORTANT: Requires reference topic: checkins — fetch via get_reference first (skip if still visible in your context) for schedule types, the required field per type, plan gating (cron needs the Business plan), and the timezone format.

cron_schedule.description: Cron expression defining when the check-in is expected to report, e.g. '0 5 * * *'. Required for cron schedules.

cron_timezone.description: Optional timezone for the cron schedule. Rails/ActiveSupport zone name (e.g. 'Eastern Time (US & Canada)', 'London'), NOT an IANA identifier like 'America/New_York'. Defaults to UTC.

grace_period.description: Optional amount of time to allow a late report before alerting, e.g. '5 minutes'

project_id.description: The ID of the project to create the check-in in

report_period.description: How often the check-in is expected to report, e.g. '1 day', '30 minutes'. Required for simple schedules.

schedule_type.description: The schedule type: 'simple' (report every fixed period) or 'cron' (report on a cron schedule)

slug.description: Optional URL-friendly identifier used to report the check-in (e.g. 'nightly-backups')

tools.name: update_check_in
tools.description: Update an existing check-in. Only the provided fields are changed; fields cannot be cleared once set. The schedule type cannot be changed after creation. IMPORTANT: Requires reference topic: checkins — fetch via get_reference first (skip if still visible in your context) for schedule fields, plan gating, and the timezone format.

check_in_id.description: The ID of the check-in to update

cron_schedule.description: Cron expression defining when the check-in is expected to report. Used by cron schedules.

cron_timezone.description: Timezone for the cron schedule. Rails/ActiveSupport zone name (e.g. 'Eastern Time (US & Canada)', 'London'), NOT an IANA identifier like 'America/New_York'.

grace_period.description: Amount of time to allow a late report before alerting, e.g. '5 minutes'

project_id.description: The ID of the project the check-in belongs to

report_period.description: How often the check-in is expected to report, e.g. '1 day', '30 minutes'. Used by simple schedules.

slug.description: URL-friendly identifier used to report the check-in

tools.name: delete_check_in
tools.description: Delete a check-in. This also deletes the check-in's reporting history. Deleting takes two calls: the first deletes nothing and returns a preview with a confirmation token. Show the preview to the user, and only if they approve, call again with the same arguments and confirm set to that token.

check_in_id.description: The ID of the check-in to delete

confirm.description: Confirmation token from this tool's previous preview. Pass it only after the user has approved the deletion shown in that preview.

project_id.description: The ID of the project the check-in belongs to

tools.name: create_project
tools.description: Create a new Honeybadger project

account_id.description: The account ID to associate the project with. If omitted, the project is created in the first account your auth token has access to.

disable_public_links.description: Whether to allow fault details to be publicly shareable via a button on the fault detail page

name.description: The name of the new project

purge_days.description: The number of days to retain data (up to the max number of days available to your subscription plan)

resolve_errors_on_deploy.description: Whether all unresolved faults should be marked as resolved when a deploy is recorded

source_url.description: A URL format like 'https://gitlab.com/username/reponame/blob/[sha]/[file]#L[line]' that is used to link lines in the backtrace to your git browser

user_search_field.description: A field such as 'context.user_email' that you provide in your error context

user_url.description: A URL format like 'http://example.com/admin/users/[user_id]' that will be displayed on the fault detail page

tools.name: list_streams
tools.description: List Insights data streams for a Honeybadger project. Streams partition Insights event data (e.g. default vs internal).

project_id.description: The ID of the project to list streams for

tools.name: query_insights
tools.description: Execute a BadgerQL query against Insights data. Requires reference topics: queries, badgerql (fetch via get_reference; skip topics still visible in your context). To visualize or share results, also fetch the charts topic.

project_id.description: The ID of the project to query insights for

query.description: BadgerQL query string to execute against your Insights data

stream_ids.description: Optional list of stream IDs to restrict the query to specific Insights streams. Use list_streams to discover a project's stream IDs; pass the 'id' field (not the slug). Omit to query all streams. Passing only unrecognized IDs yields an error, not an empty result.

timezone.description: IANA timezone identifier (e.g., 'America/New_York') for timestamp interpretation

ts.description: Time range - shortcuts like 'today', 'week', or ISO 8601 duration (e.g., 'PT3H'). Defaults to PT3H.

tools.name: list_alarms
tools.description: List all Insights alarms for a Honeybadger project. To interpret alarm configuration, fetch reference topic: alarms (via get_reference).

project_id.description: The ID of the project

tools.name: get_alarm
tools.description: Get a single Insights alarm by ID. To interpret alarm configuration, fetch reference topic: alarms (via get_reference).

project_id.description: The ID of the project

alarm_id.description: The ID of the alarm to retrieve

tools.name: get_alarm_history
tools.description: Get the trigger history for an Insights alarm. To interpret trigger records and alarm states, fetch reference topic: alarms (via get_reference).

project_id.description: The ID of the project

alarm_id.description: The ID of the alarm to get history for

tools.name: create_alarm
tools.description: Create a new Insights alarm for a Honeybadger project. IMPORTANT: Requires reference topics: alarms, queries, badgerql — fetch via get_reference first (skip topics still visible in your context) for the trigger_config schema and query guidelines. Verify the query returns the expected results via query_insights before creating the alarm.

project_id.description: The ID of the project

query.description: BadgerQL query for the alarm (e.g., 'filter event_type::str == "notice"'). The alarm system wraps the query to count results automatically.

evaluation_period.description: How often the alarm is evaluated (e.g., 5m, 1h, 1d). Minimum 1m.

lookback_lag.description: Delay before evaluating to allow data to arrive (e.g., 1m, or 0s for no lag).

trigger_config.description: JSON object defining when to trigger the alarm. Example: {"type": "alert_result_count", "config": {"operator": "gt", "value": 10}}

stream_ids.description: Optional JSON array of stream IDs to query. Omit to query every stream on the project. Use the opaque IDs from list_streams, not slugs like "default": unrecognized IDs are silently dropped, and if none survive the API returns 422 "stream_ids: cannot be empty".

tools.name: update_alarm
tools.description: Update an existing Insights alarm. IMPORTANT: Requires reference topics: alarms, queries, badgerql — fetch via get_reference first (skip topics still visible in your context) for the trigger_config schema and query guidelines.

project_id.description: The ID of the project

query.description: BadgerQL query for the alarm (e.g., 'filter event_type::str == "notice"'). The alarm system wraps the query to count results automatically.

evaluation_period.description: How often the alarm is evaluated (e.g., 5m, 1h, 1d). Minimum 1m.

lookback_lag.description: Delay before evaluating to allow data to arrive (e.g., 1m, or 0s for no lag).

trigger_config.description: JSON object defining when to trigger the alarm. Example: {"type": "alert_result_count", "config": {"operator": "gt", "value": 10}}

stream_ids.description: Optional JSON array of stream IDs to query. Omit to query every stream on the project. Use the opaque IDs from list_streams, not slugs like "default": unrecognized IDs are silently dropped, and if none survive the API returns 422 "stream_ids: cannot be empty".

alarm_id.description: The ID of the alarm to update

tools.name: delete_alarm
tools.description: Delete an Insights alarm. Deleting takes two calls: the first deletes nothing and returns a preview with a confirmation token. Show the preview to the user, and only if they approve, call again with the same arguments and confirm set to that token.

project_id.description: The ID of the project

alarm_id.description: The ID of the alarm to delete

confirm.description: Confirmation token from this tool's previous preview. Pass it only after the user has approved the deletion shown in that preview.

tools.name: get_project_integrations
tools.description: Get a list of integrations (channels) for a Honeybadger project

project_id.description: The ID of the project
